item.text: Inspecting the JSON to find the year-end long-term debt value, then I’ll return the exact one-line answer format.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json,re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMAZON_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    s=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'long[- ]term debt|long[- ]term borrowings|long[- ]term obligations', s, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'LABEL',t.get('label'))
        print(s[:2000].replace('\\n',' '))
        print('---')
PY"
